sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract

sections.notes: LSQ gradients, limiter and positivity control active; no independent smooth-order convergence study.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods

sections.title: MPI

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight tracked packages validate; Re200 waveform and St supported, while M015/M080 laminar drag is elevated relative to reviewed peers.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
